entities.name: Assault on Delverhaugh
entities.description: An Eldraine folktale of a redcap raid on the Grand Ball at Delverhaugh.

entities.name: Grand Ball at Delverhaugh
entities.description: A ball attended by dwarves and the humans Ash, Goddric and Maurice, raided by redcaps.

entities.name: Delverhaugh
entities.description: The place where the Grand Ball was held.

entities.name: Ash
entities.description: A human guest at the Grand Ball who defended the dwarves and fled at midnight, dropping her helmet.

entities.name: Goddric
entities.description: A human guest at the Ball who revealed his draconic nature while defending the hosts.

entities.name: Maurice
entities.description: A human guest at the Grand Ball.

entities.name: Dwarves
entities.description: Hosts of the Grand Ball, long feuding with the redcaps.

entities.name: Redcaps
entities.description: Raiders who attacked the Grand Ball; long in feud with the dwarves.

entities.name: Gluttoneers
entities.description: The name given to the dwarven survivors for slaying redcaps with fruit and cakes.

entities.name: Tale of the Masked Maiden
entities.description: The story that tells of Ash, one of the Ball's guests.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane the folktale comes from.

events.summary: A long-standing dwarf-redcap feud began over a dispute about a spoon.
events.quote: began long ago with a dispute over a spoon

events.summary: Redcaps raid the Grand Ball; Ash and Goddric defend the hosts and Goddric reveals his draconic nature.
events.quote: When redcaps raided the party, Ash and Goddric defended their hosts

events.summary: The weaponless dwarves fight the redcaps with whatever is at hand in a massive food fight.
At midnight Ash flees the party, dropping her helmet.
events.quote: At the stroke of midnight, Ash fled the party, dropping her helmet in the escape.

events.summary: The dwarven survivors are dubbed the Gluttoneers for slaying dozens of redcaps with fruit and cakes.
events.quote: the dwarven survivors were dubbed the Gluttoneers

relations.quote: The feud between dwarves and redcaps began long ago
Ash and Goddric defended their hosts
